LABORATORY APPLICATIONS
GEN7
The Gen7™ C-Mode Scanning Acoustic Microscope is the latest generation in Acoustic Microscopy Imaging (AMI) innovation. Improvements include the latest cutting-edge technology, advanced features, aesthetics, and ergonomics, the Gen7 is our most flexible instrument and takes acoustic imaging to the next level.
